source.title: Why 40% Of America's Salad Comes From One Company

notes: (originally filed as case 'cnbc_taylor_farms') Full visual inspection of the opening segment (00:00-03:15). CNBC uses StatTag/AnimatedCounter overlays on headline financial figures, PieChart for market breakdown, ChapterCard for segment transitions, and DocumentCard/ArchivalFrame for news clippings and FDA notices, while leaving narrative commentary and fast B-roll undecorated. | 2026-09-08: m26-m28 had acceptable[] widened to Timeline, the component the side-by-side render judged better, and each says so in its own `why`. Nothing else was re-marked — the rest of this case still needs the pass BASELINE.md asks for, by someone who has watched it. Two of BASELINE's three named examples turned out not to need a change: v3's BulletList on 'three different segments' sits on m15, which is `unmappable` and was never scored as an error; and its StepFlow on 'hundreds of family farms' cannot be added to m18, because m18 is an anchor-class mark and StepFlow carries no anchor type, so D86 forbids the placement outright. `overlays check` refused that edit, which is the case checker doing its job.
